name: RUN PEPE RUN
tagline: DODGE THE SWARM ROUND THE TRACK · BRING YOUR TEAM BACK · UP TO 8
howto: A TRACK RUNS RIGHT ROUND THE WATCHER. START IN THE BLUE CORNER, RUN THE WHOLE LAP CLOCKWISE AND REACH THE GOLD FINISH, JUST ACROSS THE STREAM FROM WHERE YOU STARTED.
THE SWARM WANDERS EVERY STRETCH. TOUCH ONE AND YOU'RE DOWN, IN A GLOWING CIRCLE WHERE YOU FELL. THE CORNERS ARE SAFE.
RUN THROUGH A DOWNED TEAMMATE'S CIRCLE TO BRING THEM BACK (THEY CAN'T BE TOUCHED FOR A MOMENT).
ONE OF YOU REACHING THE FINISH CLEARS THE LEVEL FOR EVERYONE, AND THE DOWNED COME BACK. EVERYONE DOWN AT ONCE ENDS THE RUN.
EVERY LEVEL BRINGS MORE OF THE SWARM, FASTER: QUICK RUG PULLERS FROM LEVEL 3, BIG SLOW EXTRACTORS FROM LEVEL 5.

XP: THE FIRST PEPE TO THE FINISH TAKES ITS TOME (THE MOST XP), EVERY CLEARED LEVEL GIVES EVERYONE SOME, TOMES LIE ON THE TRACK, AND BRINGING A TEAMMATE BACK PAYS TOO. EVERY PEPE LEVEL IS A SKILL POINT (K): LEARN 4 OF THE 8 SKILLS, EACH UP TO RANK 3, ON Q E R F. ROOT, FROST NOVA, SHOVE AND SNARE HOLD THE SWARM OFF; BLINK, SPRINT, QUICK FEET AND LIFELINE ARE FOR YOU.

ITEMS LIE ON THE TRACK: WALK OVER ONE TO TAKE IT (SIX SLOTS, KEYS 1-6): SWIFT SNEAKERS, BLINK FEATHER, ROOT WAND, FROST ORB, MAGNET, LUCKY CLOVER, AND THE RARE SHIELD CHARM AND RESCUE FLARE. LEVELS, SKILLS AND ITEMS LAST THE WHOLE RUN.
WASD OR ARROWS RUN (OR CLICK, OR THE THUMB STICK ON A PHONE). WHAT YOU SEE IS WHAT THE SERVER CHECKS: THE SWARM IS SHOWN WHERE IT IS WHEN YOUR PEPE GETS THERE.
